name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: My clients right now are HVAC, electrical, and plumbing contractors. I build the automation that books their jobs and follows up with their customers, so I know the owner is on a job site, not at a desk, and that a straight answer on the phone beats any deck. That's the customer this role keeps, and it's why Workyard stood out.

The job you describe, half program and half book, is how I already work. At Birdeye I retained all but one of my 15-20 reseller partners by watching utilization data in Salesforce and stepping in before adoption gaps turned into churn, and I built the automated training sequences that reached every account in between. At Wix I onboarded 25+ small businesses a month for two years. In HubSpot and GoHighLevel I've built segmented onboarding, reactivation, and review sequences, and I use Claude every day to pull apart exports and draft campaigns. As the first dedicated retention hire, I'd start by testing the health score against the accounts that actually churned.
I'd welcome a conversation about the book. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
